name: SMT101x Sensors
description: Bring your SMT101 tablet's built-in sensors and controls into Kiosk Satellite. See temperature, humidity, and distance readings, check door inputs, and control relays and RGB lighting on supported models. Everything runs locally on the tablet, without a separate MQTT server. The plugin can also restart the tablet's built-in MQTT client if it stops.
author: Stuart Pearson

settings.title: Automatically re-enable disabled tablet MQTT
settings.description: Turn the tablet's MQTT switch back on if it has been disabled. Requires automatic recovery. Leave off if you want to be able to turn MQTT off yourself. Host MQTT capture broker on this tablet. Turning MQTT on does not guarantee that readings are reaching the plugin.

settings.title: Automatically recover stopped built-in MQTT client
settings.description: Restart the tablet's built-in MQTT client if it stops, so readings can resume. Works on supported firmware once the local broker is listening. Checks once a minute and waits five minutes between recovery attempts. Does not fix a client that is running but disconnected. Leaves MQTT switched off unless automatic re-enabling is also enabled.
